title: Regeneron pledges $2B to convert former magazine factory into drug plant: NY governor
summary: In a bid to deepen its manufacturing foothold in the U.S., Regeneron Pharmaceuticals in April pledged production and infrastructure investments surpassing $7 billion across North Carolina and its native Empire State. Now, more than half a year later, the expansion plan for one of the company’s new facilities—a former magazine plant in Saratoga Springs, New York—is coming into focus.
